# ExcaliburFX

ExcaliburFX is a motion-design extension for editing workflows. Its website documents and links to curve presets, keyframe tools, expressions, color controls, command chains, shake presets, and sound effects.

The website and product information are published by Physic. The site is in English. Product downloads and source releases are hosted on GitHub.

## Key pages

- [Home and feature overview](https://excaliburfx-website.vercel.app/): product summary, feature gallery, downloads, and contact form.
- [How to use ExcaliburFX](https://excaliburfx-website.vercel.app/pages/howToUse.html): installation instructions and feature guide.
- [Latest GitHub release](https://github.com/Physicprog/ExcaliburFX/releases/latest): canonical release page and source repository.
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/Physicprog/ExcaliburFX/releases/latest/download/ExcaliburFX.Installer.exe)
- [CEP extension package](https://github.com/Physicprog/ExcaliburFX/releases/latest/download/com.excaliburfx.cep.zxp)
- [Contact the publisher](mailto:excaliburfx@outlook.fr)

## Feature overview

- Save and apply custom Bézier curves to keyframes, and copy or paste graph data across timeline selections.
- Apply curves directly to keyframes with Live Curves.
- Work with timeline layers and a library of built-in expressions.
- Build and reuse command chains and effect presets.
- Preview, import, and adjust sound effects.
- Customize the interface, themes, and visible menus.
